VERIFIED CORRECT (no drift, no gap): (1) Line citations for Edit 1 all match the live file exactly -- line 285 (test name), lines 292-296 (preceding assert block), lines 297-301 (comment+refute block to delete), line 302 (`end`); the design's quoted 'current text' blocks are byte-identical to what is actually in the file. (2) AC1's positive-half assertion (lines 294-295, `assert table_exists_in_schema?(schema_name, table)` and its failure message) is untouched by the proposed edit -- confirmed by direct comparison, survives intact. (3) `grep -n 'table_exists_in_schema?("public"' test/letflow/definitions/migrations_test.exs` returns exactly one hit, line 300 -- the one being deleted; no other test in the file references it or the renamed test description. (4) `grep -n 'never in public|public half|:prefix guard|prefix guard'` on test/specs/REQ-027.md returns exactly one hit, line 110, inside the 8-line block (lines 107-114) the design replaces verbatim -- design's quoted current text matches the live file exactly, and no other test case (2-20) references the deleted material. (5) Guard-test citation test/letflow/event_store/migrations_test.exs:484 confirmed via grep -n: exact test name match, no drift from the design's '~line 484' citation (in fact exact, not merely approximate). (6) No implementation code present in the design-doc sense: the quoted before/after blocks are verbatim test-file text for a mechanical deletion/rename fix (the correct and necessary form for this task type), not new production logic standing in for ELIXIR-DEV's own implementation decisions.

BLOCKING DEFECT (independently found, not in ISSUE-FIXER's diagnosis or CODE-DESIGNER's own summary): the design's own three sub-steps for Edit 1 directly contradict each other on the fate of the blank line currently at line 296. Sec 2a's literal instruction is 'Delete lines 297-301 in full' (5 lines only). Sec 2b states explicitly (line 85 of the design doc): 'No other change to this line or to lines 292, 294-296' -- i.e. line 296 (the blank line) is declared unchanged. Sec 2c then asserts the opposite: 'The blank line that currently sits at line 296 ... is also removed as part of deleting 297-301, so the loop body has no internal blank line' and shows a 'net shape' with zero blank lines before `end`. These cannot both be true: deleting only lines 297-301 (per 2a, reaffirmed by 2b) necessarily leaves line 296's blank line in place immediately before `end`, which does not match the exact final shape asserted in 2c. An implementer following the design's own literal, numbered edit instructions (2a+2b) produces a result inconsistent with the design's own claimed correct end-state (2c) -- this is precisely the kind of ambiguity that forces ELIXIR-DEV to make an unauthorized judgment call (does the blank line get deleted or not?) rather than apply the design verbatim. Per WF-02 Step 1b check 2a (no deferral/ambiguity) and this role's explicit mandate to FAIL immediately on any single failed check with no partial credit, this is sufficient on its own to FAIL the design, independent of the fact that every other check above passed cleanly.

Edit 2 (test/specs/REQ-027.md) has no equivalent defect and would pass in isolation, but per 'FAIL immediately and completely on any single failed check -- no partial credit,' the whole design artefact is FAILed, not just Edit 1.
